title: Moonbrook Schoolhouse
wikitext:
[[Image:Moonbrook Schoolhouse.jpg|thumb|300px|Moonbrook Schoolhouse]]
The '''Moonbrook Schoolhouse''' is a building located in [[Moonbrook]] around southern [[Westfall]] and looks somewhat like a town hall. There is a cemetery behind it. It is the building in north-westernmost Moonbrook.

Adventurers are sent to the schoolhouse to find a letter in a footlocker that appeared in the main room of the ground floor, just short of the elevated part.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|28|The Legend of Stalvan (2)|The Legend of Stalvan}}</ref> It was revealed that the schoolhouse was built specifically for [[Stalvan Mistmantle]],<ref>[[A Dusty Unsent Letter]]</ref> who eventually became its headmaster.<ref>[[An Undelivered Letter]]</ref>
